key_issues_to_review.issue_content: `provision` acquires the repository lock for worktree mode and then discards the release function with `_ = release`. The old code used `defer release()`. The lock is never released, so every later operation that needs the same project lock (another card's `provision`, `mergeLocal`, and so on) can block indefinitely. The new tests may not catch this if `LockRepository` is re-entrant for the same checkout context. Whether the lock is re-entrant is the one thing I couldn't confirm from the diff. Even so, the hold would leak across cards. The release should be deferred, or the lock scoped to the section that needs it.

The commit diff changed from `git diff <sha>^!` to `git show --format= --root <sha>^0`. For a merge commit, `git diff X^!` showed the diff against the first parent. `git show` instead produces a combined diff (`--cc`), which is empty for clean merges and has a different format otherwise. The `merge_commit` strategy creates merge commits in the workspace history, so selecting one in the commit list can return an empty or differently formatted patch. Adding `-m --first-parent`, or `--diff-merges=first-parent` on Git 2.31 and later, would keep the old behavior.
